opening.text: Think about packing for a long trip. You don't throw things in a bag at the last minute. You check the weather. You make a list. You pack what matters most. The better you pack, the better the trip goes. The temple is like that. How we prepare shapes what we find there.

mainMessage.text: Going to the temple is a holy trip. A little careful packing, in heart and in home, makes it a better one.

blocks.text: **Why we pack at all** The temple is where we are changed. That is why preparing matters.

And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Covenant Confidence through Jesus Christ” from the April 2024 general conference.
The house of the Lord is where we can be transformed in higher and holier ways.
We go to be changed.
**Always ready to go** Some people keep a bag packed by the door. We can be like that with the temple. Ready any time.
For behold, this life is the time for men to prepare to meet God; yea, behold the day of this life is the day for men to perform their labors.
Elder Ulisses Soares of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Covenant Confidence through Jesus Christ” from the April 2024 general conference.
We all should be perpetually preparing to go to the house of the Lord.
Keep the bag by the door.
**Start packing today** You can't pack in a minute. Living worthy takes time. Start now, and don't wait for a date.

And inasmuch as my people build a house unto me in the name of the Lord, and do not suffer any unclean thing to come into it, that it be not defiled, my glory shall rest upon it; Yea, and my presence shall be there, for I will come into it, and all the pure in heart that shall come into it shall see God.
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Recommended to the Lord” from the October 2020 general conference.
Begin the process now to become “recommended to the Lord” so that His Spirit will be with you in abundance.
Start today.
**Packing happens at home** Most of our packing is done in our own living room. Prayer, scripture reading and kindness at home are all part of it.

Organize yourselves; prepare every needful thing; and establish a house, even a house of prayer, a house of fasting, a house of faith, a house of learning, a house of glory, a house of order, a house of God;
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Prepared to Obtain Every Needful Thing” from the April 2019 general conference.
Indeed, temple preparation is most effective in our homes.
Home is where we prepare.
**Know where the trip leads** A good trip has a destination. In the temple, everything points to the Savior.
Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Prepared to Obtain Every Needful Thing” from the April 2019 general conference.
The temple is the house of the Lord. Everything in the temple points us to our Savior, Jesus Christ.
Keep your eyes on Him.
**The pass that gets you in** A temple recommend is like a travel pass. It lets you in. But it does more than open a door.

O then, my beloved brethren, come unto the Lord, the Holy One. Remember that his paths are righteous. Behold, the way for man is narrow, but it lieth in a straight course before him, and the keeper of the gate is the Holy One of Israel; and he employeth no servant there; and there is none other way save it be by the gate; for he cannot be deceived, for the Lord God is his name.
Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Recommended to the Lord” from the October 2020 general conference.
Your temple recommend opens the gates of heaven for you and others with rites and ordinances of eternal significance.
It opens more than a door.

story.title: Moses at the burning bush

blocks.text: Moses turned aside to see a strange sight. Then God spoke to him.

And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I. And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
Moses had to slow down and show respect before he could hear God. Holy places call for that. The temple is one of them.

Train where you live.

Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
Elder David A. Bednar of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Prepared to Obtain Every Needful Thing” from the April 2019 general conference.

He is the goal.
**The reward at the gate** A recommend lets you in. But the real reward is what the temple gives to you and your family.

Elder Ronald A. Rasband of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles said this in his talk “Recommended to the Lord” from the October 2020 general conference.

story.title: Naaman is told to wash

blocks.text: Naaman had a serious illness. The prophet gave him a simple instruction. At first he was angry. It seemed too easy.

And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean. Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
Simple steps can feel small. But they open the way to big blessings. Preparing for the temple is often a list of small things done faithfully.

story.title: Esther prepares to see the king

blocks.text: Esther had to go before the king, and it was dangerous. She did not rush in. She asked her people to fast with her first.

Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.
Esther prepared with faith, and then she went in with courage. Preparing helps us go in without fear.

story.prompt: The member tells a true time when they were ready, or not ready, for something important. If the member has none, the app offers a story from the scriptures.
story.title: The ten virgins

blocks.text: Ten young women waited for a bridegroom. Five were ready. Five were not.

Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom. And five of them were wise, and five were foolish. They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
The wise ones didn't know when he would come. So they kept oil on hand. We keep our hearts ready the same way, a little at a time.

application.text: First, decide what "oil" you need to keep on hand, such as prayer, scripture time or kindness. Second, add a little each day. Third, plan your next temple visit and keep the date.
